_what: THE READING BUDGET, spent to the end. The stone used to have no maxTries at all and its only cost stopped being charged after the third cracked bell -- a ceiling ch5's collapsed stair and two failed bell rounds can put a table on before the puzzle even starts. So a three-role table facing 8 or 12 boards walked them, and from the fourth reading nothing mechanical happened at all. Now there are FOUR readings. This script spends all four: the first three each crack a bell, the fourth is charged when there is no bell left to charge it to, and then the Provost reads the stone herself. WALK_UNLOCKED and LAW0 still open -- what losing costs in ch7 and ch8 is not a decision Chapter VI may take alone (ADVERSARIAL OPEN 2) -- but STONE_TOLD records it, Marrow says it, and the ledger prints it. An unfinished board is still free and still spends no reading (R10.19).
